review.overall_explanation: The final diff removes only the uncalled private facade helper and its import; the regenerated patch replays cleanly and its declared patch and target hashes match the checked-out bytes. The host approval changes synchronously revoke grants on close, preserve replacement approvals across late opening results, and reject late results for already-closed sessions, with tests covering both pending and completed native cleanup. The PTY declarations match the installed dependency contract. No actionable defect was found in the reviewed change.
